title: Easy Chicken Marbella
description: The famous chicken Marbella first made an appearance at New York's Silver Palate Shop; with this recipe, you can easily make a legendary meal at home.
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, or more to taste, pounded thin and cut in half
0.5 cup capers, with extra liquid added
10 cloves garlic, crushed, or more to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Combine chicken, wine, prunes, olive oil, vinegar, capers and liquid, brown sugar, oregano, parsley, olives, garlic, bay leaves, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap or transfer mixture to 2 resealable plastic bags; marinate in the refrigerator for 12 to 24 hours, the longer the better.
Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C).
Transfer chicken and marinade to a 9x13-inch baking dish.

Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is no longer pink in centers and the juices run clear, about 40 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into centers should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
